description: Check what an AI agent can do on a business's website (message, book, order, sign up, pay, change or cancel), and its agentic score. Waits up to 25 seconds; if the read is not done, call again for the score. Set fresh after the site changed. Use it when a person asks how agent-ready a business is, or wants to improve their own; to find businesses, use search_businesses. A setup link in the answer is for the owner to fill in.

fresh.description: Read the site again rather than answer the stored result: for a business that just changed its site. Allowed a few minutes after the last read; before that, the stored result is answered with when to ask again.

url.description: The business's website, as a URL or a bare domain like salon.example.

name: check_business

outputSchema.description: Every field is described in this tool's outputSchema at https://network.surfingdog.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.
